frontier.hypothesis: A 36-instruction chassis whose PREHEADER expands to four MORE pre-combine insns - all live at flow time and all absorbed by combine - closes the function, because preheader insns lengthen the counter's live range and never the end pointer's.
frontier.mechanism: flow.c:1685 counts a preheader insn for allocno 73 (measured +1 with rejected/preheader-foldable-chain-plus1-only.c, stream unchanged at 26 cc1 insns) and never for allocno 78, which is not live there. live(73) 23 -> 27 ties pri at 8888 and the decl-order swap (memory/grind/func_80037B00/decl_order_swap_vC.c) then seats the end pointer first via global.c:655's lower-allocno tie-break.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate expression spellings of the preheader's two statements (`var_t3 = D_800A38C8;` and `var_a3 = (s8 *)&D_80102810;`) whose EXPANSION is naturally multi-insn and whose extra insns are absorbed by combine rather than constant-folded by cse1 and deleted by flow: address computations GCC expands through an intermediate (reaching the table via a subscript or member expression, a (s8 *)((s32)X + k) round trip), or the bound read through a narrower type that widens. Screen with tmp/grind/func_80037B00/s10/probe.sh and accept only rows where the counter shows `used 8 times across >= 27 insns`, the end pointer still shows `used 4 times across 9 insns`, and the cc1 insn count is still 26; confirm with `& tools/wteng.ps1 main sandbox func_80037B00 --disable all`. POLICY BOUNDARY: the extra insns must be the natural expansion of a statement the function genuinely needs. A chain written purely to lengthen a live range is semantically purposeless (T1/T2/T3 FAIL) and at best the F1 combine-foldable chain-extender family, which this session measured caps at +1 anyway.

frontier.hypothesis: A 36-instruction chassis in which the counter CHANGES liveness state in an after-the-inner-loop block makes that block's insns visible to flow's live_length accumulator, which is worth the full +4 at zero byte cost.
frontier.mechanism: flow.c:1685's regs_sometimes_live gate is precisely why block_74 is free today (measured: block_74 insns move allocno 75 from 9 to 13 refs but leave 73 at 23 live). If the counter were dead on the `return 1` arm and re-live at block_74, flow would count the return-arm insns (s9/flow.rtl insns 105, 107) and the epilogue (133, 147) for it - exactly the +4 required.
